source_idea: I want an app to organise my stuff.

app.name: Untitled CRUD app
app.description: Application idea that still needs clarification: I want an app to organise my stuff.

clarification_questions.question: What kind of records do you want to manage (for example tasks, products, appointments, customers)?
clarification_questions.reason: The main entity of the app cannot be identified from the idea.

clarification_questions.question: What information should be stored for each record (for example name, date, quantity, status)?
clarification_questions.reason: Fields and their types are needed to build forms and validation.

clarification_questions.question: Who will use the app?
clarification_questions.reason: Helps write user stories for the right role.
clarification_questions.suggested_default: A single person managing their own data.

assumptions: The app is used by one person in one browser; data is stored in localStorage.
Every record automatically gets id, created_at and updated_at system fields.
